body.objective: Prevent an uncommitted or unregistered work-item draft in the shared worktree from entering the authoritative READY queue or displacing an already accepted next pull, while continuing to honor legitimate command-generated lease and lifecycle events before their repository commit is integrated.
body.stop_condition: Introduce an explicit deterministic admission boundary between work-item definition drafts and authoritative programme items. A definition becomes queue-eligible only if it is present with the same content hash in the configured committed programme baseline, or is admitted by a coordinator-owned append-only WORK_ITEM_REGISTER/PROPOSE event emitted through a documented command and linked to the definition hash. Plain filesystem discovery of an untracked, modified or otherwise unregistered definition must type it as WORKTREE_DRAFT, exclude it from READY/next-pull/work-pull/dependency satisfaction, and list it in a compact advisory section with its path, hash and safe register/discard commands. Preserve immediate folding of legitimate command-generated ACTIVE, LEASE, REQUEST, INTENT and checkpoint events by giving the Science Forge event journal its own verifiable command-origin/content-addressed admission rule; do not solve the bug by ignoring all uncommitted events, which would permit double leases. Define how the committed baseline is resolved when local HEAD is stale behind origin/master and the physical worktree is only partially materialized, composing with the committed-worktree-materialization-drift request rather than trusting file presence. Add deterministic both-backend fixtures for: an untracked successor draft that sorts before an accepted READY item; a modified registered definition; two drafts created during an active proof-readiness review; a valid uncommitted command-generated lease that still suppresses a second pull; a forged hand-written lease file that is rejected or quarantined; stale local HEAD with a newer configured remote baseline; and promotion of a draft by the explicit registration operation. Overview, streams-view, work-ready and work-pull must agree byte-for-byte on the admitted queue.
body.forbid: no deletion or rewriting of drafts; no blanket exclusion of every dirty event; no treating filesystem mtime, shared Git index state or local HEAD alone as scientific authority; no automatic registration merely because a file parses; no silent trust of a hand-written ACTIVE/LEASE event; no queue mutation during a read-only overview; no physics-specific filename exception; no weakening one-live-exclusive-lease semantics.
notes: Exact live reproduction at 2026-07-21T10:29:02Z: while black-hole-bh3-proof-readiness-review was ACTIVE, its writer created uncommitted worktree-only drafts planning/work-items/black-hole-bh3-numerical-validation-protocol.json and planning/work-items/black-hole-complex-frequency-analytic-continuation-gate.json. Neither blob existed in origin/master, yet overview and work-ready immediately admitted both as READY and placed the numerical protocol ahead of the already accepted Phase 1 item black-hole-symbolic-frequency-finite-flux-radiation-class.

The counterexample to a simple committed-only loader is live Observer coordination: its current ACTIVE and LEASE-ACQUIRE events are command-generated and worktree-only, and must remain authoritative enough to prevent a second exclusive pull until committed integration catches up.

Coordinator mitigation was append-only request sf:program/request/programme-phase1-viability-classification-freeze-to-black-hole-d857948aa3a1767b: preserve the useful Phase 2 drafts but gate them behind the finite-flux item. The substrate fix must make such drafts advisory by default, so queue order cannot change before explicit admission.

This composes with bug-science-forge-committed-worktree-materialization-drift: a blob may be committed in the authoritative baseline yet absent from the physical worktree, while a draft may be physically present yet absent from every authoritative commit. Admission and materialization are related but distinct checks.
